sql_templates.insider_bulk_deals_query:
WITH latest_stage AS (
    SELECT symbol, stage, trading_signal, stage_score, technical_score, snapshot_date
    FROM scores.stage_snapshots
    WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots)
),
latest_eod AS (
    SELECT symbol, close, volume
    FROM market.equity_eod
    WHERE trade_date = (SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM market.equity_eod)
)
SELECT b.symbol, b.deal_date, b.qty, b.price, i.alert_date, i.insider_score, s.stage, s.trading_signal
FROM signals.bulk_block_deals b
JOIN latest_stage s ON b.symbol = s.symbol
JOIN latest_eod e ON b.symbol = e.symbol
LEFT JOIN signals.insider_alerts i ON b.symbol = i.symbol
WHERE s.trading_signal IN ('BUY', 'STRONG_BUY')
ORDER BY b.deal_date DESC
LIMIT 100;
